-- BALANCE: core scaling formulas (tweak exponents to make progression faster/slower).
local Balance = {}

-- shovel damage per hit, from its odds (1 in N). Set Power on a shovel in RNGConfig to override.
--   1 in 2 -> 1   | 1 in 1K -> 18 | 1 in 1M -> 330 | 1 in 1B -> 6K | 1 in 100B -> 40K
Balance.PowerExponent = 0.42
function Balance.ShovelPower(chance)
	return math.max(1, math.floor(chance ^ Balance.PowerExponent))
end

-- luck each EQUIPPED shovel gives (added up, then multiplied with every other luck source)
-- Diminishing shovel luck reduces the runaway rare-shovel -> more-luck feedback loop.
Balance.LuckExponent = 0.33
function Balance.ShovelLuck(chance)
	return chance ^ Balance.LuckExponent
end

return Balance

U.Limits = {EggDiscount = {0, 0.5}, DoubleRollChance = {0, 0.5}, RollAnimScale = {0.6, 1}, ReachMult = {1, 1.5}, SpinMult = {1, 1.6}, WalkSpeed = {16, 40}, PetBoostMult = {1, 2}, FriendBoost = {0, 0.2}}
-- lookups
U.ById, U.TreeById = {}, {}
for _, tree in ipairs(U.Trees) do
	U.TreeById[tree.Id] = tree
	tree.ByPos = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(tree.Nodes) do
		n.Tree = tree.Id
		U.ById[n.Id] = n
		tree.ByPos[n.Q .. "," .. n.R] = n
	end
end

local DIRS = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}, {1, -1}, {-1, 1}}
function U.Neighbours(n)
	local tree = U.TreeById[n.Tree]
	local out = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(DIRS) do
		local nb = tree.ByPos[(n.Q + d[1]) .. "," .. (n.R + d[2])]
		if nb then table.insert(out, nb) end
	end
	return out
end
function U.Distance(n) return math.max(math.abs(n.Q), math.abs(n.R), math.abs(n.Q + n.R)) end
function U.CostOf(n)
	if n.Cost then return n.Cost end
	local tree = U.TreeById[n.Tree]
	return math.floor(tree.BaseCost * tree.Growth ^ U.Distance(n) * (n.CostMult or 1) + 0.5)
end
-- A client and the server use the same stage and adjacency rules.
function U.LockReason(n, owned, stages)
 if owned[n.Id] then return "Owned" end
 local stage = n.RequiredStage or "Starter"
 if stage ~= "Starter" and not (stages and stages[stage]) then
  return "Unlock " .. (({Cursed = "Cursed Biome", Crystal = "Crystal Caves", Retro = "Retro World", AbsoluteZero = "Absolute Zero"})[stage] or stage) .. " first"
 end
 if n.Center then return nil end
 for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if owned[nb.Id] then return nil end end
 return "Buy a connected tile first"
end
function U.Available(n, owned, stages) return U.LockReason(n, owned, stages) == nil end
function U.Calculate(owned, friends)
 local stats, mults = table.clone(U.Base), {}
 for id, has in pairs(owned) do
  local n = has and U.ById[id]
  if n and n.Effect then
   local e = n.Effect
   if e[3] == "Mul" then mults[e[1]] = (mults[e[1]] or 1) * (1 + e[2])
   else stats[e[1]] = (stats[e[1]] or 0) + e[2] end
  end
 end
 for k, m in pairs(mults) do stats[k] *= m end
 for k, lim in pairs(U.Limits) do stats[k] = math.clamp(stats[k], lim[1], lim[2]) end
 local friendMult = 1 + stats.FriendBoost * math.clamp(friends or 0, 0, 3)
 stats.SnowMult *= friendMult
 stats.LuckMult *= friendMult
 return stats
end
return U

local function defaults(d)
	d.Counts = type(d.Counts) == "table" and d.Counts or {}
	d.TotalRolls = tonumber(d.TotalRolls) or 0
	d.Snow = tonumber(d.Snow) or 0

	d.Settings = type(d.Settings) == "table" and d.Settings or {}
	d.Luck = tonumber(d.Luck) or 1 -- roll luck multiplier (luck upgrades raise this)
	if type(d.Equipped) == "string" then d.Equipped = {d.Equipped} end
	if type(d.Equipped) ~= "table" then d.Equipped = {} end
	d.Pets = type(d.Pets) == "table" and d.Pets or {}
	d.EquippedPets = type(d.EquippedPets) == "table" and d.EquippedPets or {}
	d.PetIndex = type(d.PetIndex) == "table" and d.PetIndex or {}
	for name, n in pairs(d.Pets) do if n > 0 then d.PetIndex[name] = true end end
	return d
end

local function stat(ls, name, value)
	local v = Instance.new("IntValue")
	v.Name = name
	v.Value = value
	v.Parent = ls
end

local function load(player)
	if data[player] then return end
	local saved
	if store then
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("u" .. player.UserId) end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then saved = res end
	end
	if not player.Parent then return end
	local d = defaults(saved or {})
	data[player] = d
	player:SetAttribute("BalanceTestSession", testMode)

	local ls = Instance.new("Folder")
	ls.Name = "leaderstats"
	stat(ls, "Snow", d.Snow)
	stat(ls, "Rolls", d.TotalRolls)
	ls.Parent = player

	loaded:Fire(player, d)
end

local function save(player)
	local d = data[player]
	if store and d then
		pcall(function() store:SetAsync("u" .. player.UserId, d) end)
	end
end

function DataService.Get(player)
	return data[player]
end

-- run callback for every player whose data is loaded (now and in the future)
function DataService.OnLoaded(callback)
	for p, d in pairs(data) do task.spawn(callback, p, d) end
	return loaded.Event:Connect(callback)
end

function DataService.SetStat(player, name, value)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local v = ls and ls:FindFirstChild(name)
	if v then v.Value = value end
end

function DataService.AddSnow(player, amount)
	local d = data[player]
	if not d then return end
	d.Snow += amount
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
end

local MAX = PetConfig.MaxEquipped + 2 -- absolute max (with the +1 Pet Equip upgrades)
local function slotsFor(player) return player:GetAttribute("PetSlots") or PetConfig.MaxEquipped end
local HATCH_COOLDOWN = 2.2

local function copies(list, name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local function publish(player, d)
	player:SetAttribute("EquippedPets", table.concat(d.EquippedPets, ","))
end

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player, d)
	local clean = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(d.EquippedPets) do
		if PetConfig.PetByName[name] and copies(clean, name) < (d.Pets[name] or 0) and #clean < MAX then
			table.insert(clean, name)
		end
	end
	d.EquippedPets = clean
	publish(player, d)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) lastHatch[p] = nil; lastEquip[p] = nil end)

local function rollPet(egg)
	local total = 0
	for _, p in ipairs(egg.Pets) do total += p.Chance end
	local r = math.random() * total
	for _, p in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
		r -= p.Chance
		if r <= 0 then return p end
	end
	return egg.Pets[1]
end

local function hatch(player, egg, eggPart)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	if egg.RequiredStage and egg.RequiredStage ~= "Starter" and d.Stages[egg.RequiredStage] ~= true then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastHatch[player] and now - lastHatch[player] < HATCH_COOLDOWN then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp or (hrp.Position - eggPart.Position).Magnitude > 20 then return end
	local cost = math.floor(egg.Cost * (1 - (player:GetAttribute("EggDiscount") or 0)) + 0.5)
	if d.Snow < cost then
		hatchedEvent:FireClient(player, "NotEnough", egg.Id, cost)
		return
	end
	lastHatch[player] = now
	DataService.AddSnow(player, -cost)
	local pet = rollPet(egg)
	local isNew = not d.PetIndex[pet.Name]
	d.PetIndex[pet.Name] = true
	d.Pets[pet.Name] = (d.Pets[pet.Name] or 0) + 1
	if #d.EquippedPets < slotsFor(player) then
		table.insert(d.EquippedPets, pet.Name)
		task.delay(2.5, function() if DataService.Get(player) == d then publish(player, d) end end)
	end
	hatchedEvent:FireClient(player, "Hatched", egg.Id, pet.Name, isNew, d.Pets, d.EquippedPets, d.PetIndex)
end

	if type(name) ~= "string" or not PetConfig.PetByName[name] then return d.EquippedPets end
	if action == "equip" then
		if copies(d.EquippedPets, name) < (d.Pets[name] or 0) then
			if #d.EquippedPets >= slotsFor(player) then table.remove(d.EquippedPets, 1) end
			table.insert(d.EquippedPets, name)
		end
	elseif action == "unequip" then
		for i = #d.EquippedPets, 1, -1 do
			if d.EquippedPets[i] == name then table.remove(d.EquippedPets, i) break end
		end
	end
	publish(player, d)
	return d.EquippedPets
end

-- SnowFieldService: PERSONAL fields with tile HP.
-- Each tile has a phase (0-3 layers left) and HP for its top layer.
-- Every shovel arm that sweeps over a tile deals its Power as damage; at 0 HP the layer breaks and pays out.
-- Updates are sent only to the owning player as triples: index, phase, hpPercent.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Balance = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Balance"))
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldUpdate")
local syncFunc = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldSync")
local collectedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowCollected")

local TICK = 0.2
local TS = SF.TileSize
local SPEED = SF.Spinner.Speed
local R_IN, R_OUT = SF.Spinner.Inner, SF.Spinner.Outer
local TWO_PI = math.pi * 2
local MAX = SF.MaxPhase

local defs = {}
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
	defs[f.Id] = {def = f, origin = SF.Origin(f), maxHP = math.max(1, f.TileHP or 1)}
end

-- states[player][fieldId] = {phases = {}, hp = {}, pending = {}}
local states = {}
local function getStates(player)
	local st = states[player]
	if not st then
		st = {}
		for id, d in pairs(defs) do
			local n = d.def.Width * d.def.Depth
			st[id] = {phases = table.create(n, MAX), hp = table.create(n, d.maxHP), pending = {}}
		end
		states[player] = st
	end
	return st
end

local lastTime = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	states[p] = nil
	lastTime[p] = nil
end)

local function pct(hp, maxHP) return math.clamp(math.floor(hp / maxHP * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100) end

syncFunc.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local out = {}
	for id, s in pairs(getStates(player)) do
		local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
		local hp = table.create(#s.hp, 100)
		for i, v in ipairs(s.hp) do hp[i] = pct(v, maxHP) end
		out[id] = {p = table.concat(s.phases), h = hp}
	end
	return out
end

local function flush(player, st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		if next(s.pending) then
			local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
			local flat = {}
			for i in pairs(s.pending) do
				flat[#flat + 1] = i
				flat[#flat + 1] = s.phases[i]
				flat[#flat + 1] = pct(s.hp[i], maxHP)
			end
			s.pending = {}
			updateEvent:FireClient(player, id, flat)
		end
	end
end

-- damage per arm, from each equipped shovel's Power
local function armPowers(player)
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels")
	local list = {}
	if not attr or attr == "" then return list end
	for name in attr:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local item = Config.ByName[name]
		table.insert(list, item and (item.Power or Balance.ShovelPower(item.Chance)) or 1)
	end
	return list
end

local function collect(player, st, now)
	local prev = lastTime[player]
	lastTime[player] = now
	if not prev then return end
	local powers = armPowers(player)
	local spd = SPEED * (player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1)
	local rOut = R_OUT * (player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1)
	local bonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0
	local pmult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1
	local n = #powers
	if n == 0 then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

	local sweep = math.min((now - prev) * spd, TWO_PI)
	local pos = root.Position
	local gained = 0

	for id, d in pairs(defs) do
		local f, origin, maxHP = d.def, d.origin, d.maxHP
		if f.Style and f.Style ~= "Starter" and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. f.Style) ~= true then continue end -- stage locked
		local lx, lz = pos.X - origin.X, pos.Z - origin.Z
		if lx > -rOut and lz > -rOut and lx < f.Width * TS + rOut and lz < f.Depth * TS + rOut
			and math.abs(pos.Y - origin.Y) < 9 then
			local s = st[id]
			local x0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lx - rOut) / TS))
			local x1 = math.min(f.Width - 1, math.floor((lx + rOut) / TS))
			local z0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lz - rOut) / TS))
			local z1 = math.min(f.Depth - 1, math.floor((lz + rOut) / TS))
			for k = 0, n - 1 do
				local dmg = (powers[k + 1] + bonus) * pmult
				local a0 = prev * spd + k * (TWO_PI / n) + (player.UserId % 7)
				for x = x0, x1 do
					for z = z0, z1 do
						local i = z * f.Width + x + 1
						if s.phases[i] > 0 then
							local dx = origin.X + (x + 0.5) * TS - pos.X
							local dz = origin.Z + (z + 0.5) * TS - pos.Z
							local d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz
							if d2 >= R_IN * R_IN and d2 <= rOut * rOut
								and (math.atan2(dz, dx) - a0) % TWO_PI <= sweep then
								local hp = s.hp[i] - dmg
								local p = s.phases[i]
								-- strong shovels can break several layers in one hit
								while hp <= 0 and p > 0 do
									p -= 1
									gained += f.SnowPerPhase
									hp += maxHP
								end
								if p == 0 then hp = maxHP end
								s.phases[i] = p
								s.hp[i] = hp
								s.pending[i] = true
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if gained > 0 then
		-- equipped pets boost the snow you earn
		local pets = {}
		for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
		gained = math.max(1, math.floor(gained * (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1) + 0.5))
		DataService.AddSnow(player, gained)
		collectedEvent:FireClient(player, gained)
	end
end

local function regrow(st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		local d = defs[id]
		local chance = 1 / d.def.RegrowSeconds
		for i, p in ipairs(s.phases) do
			if p < MAX and math.random() < chance then
				s.phases[i] = p + 1
				s.hp[i] = d.maxHP
				s.pending[i] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

local acc, regrowAcc = 0, 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	acc += dt
	regrowAcc += dt
	if acc < TICK then return end
	acc = 0
	local doRegrow = regrowAcc >= 1
	if doRegrow then regrowAcc = 0 end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local st = getStates(player)
		collect(player, st, now)
		if doRegrow then regrow(st) end
		flush(player, st)
	end
end)

local friendCount = {}

local function owned(d)
	local set = {}
	for id, v in pairs(d.Upgrades) do if v and U.ById[id] then set[id] = true end end
	return set
end

local function apply(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	local set = owned(d)
	local stats = U.Calculate(set, friendCount[player] or 0)
	for k, v in pairs(stats) do player:SetAttribute(k, v) end
	player:SetAttribute("FriendsHere", friendCount[player] or 0)
	for id in pairs(U.ById) do player:SetAttribute("Up_" .. id, set[id] == true) end
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = stats.WalkSpeed end
end

local function recountFriends()
	local list = Players:GetPlayers()
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do
		task.spawn(function()
			local n = 0
			for _, other in ipairs(list) do
				if other ~= p then
					local ok, isFriend = pcall(function() return p:IsFriendsWith(other.UserId) end)
					if ok and isFriend then n += 1 end
				end
			end
			friendCount[p] = n
			apply(p)
		end)
	end
end

	apply(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.defer(apply, player) end)
	recountFriends()

		local t = makeTile(board, {Name = tree.Name, Id = "Pick_" .. tree.Id}, Vector2.new((i - 2) * 270, 0), 115, tree.Color)
		setHexColor(t.fill, tree.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.25))
		t.name.TextSize = 40
		t.price.Text = done .. "/" .. #tree.Nodes
		t.price.TextColor3 = WHITE
		t.hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(t.scale, 0.12, {Scale = 1.06}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
		t.hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(t.scale, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
		t.hit.Activated:Connect(function() openTree(tree) end)
	end
end

refresh = function()
	snowLabel.Text = "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(snow())
	if not currentTree then return end
	local set = ownedSet()
	local done = 0
	for id, t in pairs(tiles) do
		local n = t.node
		local have = set[id]
		local avail = U.Available(n, set, stageSet())
		if have then done += 1 end
		if have then
			setHexColor(t.fill, n.Center and CENTER_FILL or OWNED_FILL)
			setHexColor(t.border, WHITE)
			t.glow.Visible = true
			t.fillGroup.GroupTransparency = 0
			t.name.TextTransparency = 0
			t.price.Text = ""
		elseif avail then
			setHexColor(t.fill, n.Center and CENTER_FILL or AVAIL_FILL)
			setHexColor(t.border, currentTree.Color)
			t.glow.Visible = false
			t.fillGroup.GroupTransparency = 0
			t.name.TextTransparency = 0
			t.price.Text = "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n))
			t.price.TextColor3 = snow() >= U.CostOf(n) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
		else
			setHexColor(t.fill, LOCK_FILL)
			setHexColor(t.border, Color3.fromRGB(70, 78, 98))
			t.glow.Visible = false
			t.fillGroup.GroupTransparency = 0.1
			t.name.TextTransparency = 0.45
			t.price.Text = (n.RequiredStage ~= "Starter" and not stageSet()[n.RequiredStage]) and n.RequiredStage or ""
			t.price.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 200)
		end
		t.holder.ZIndex = (selected == n) and 3 or 2
	end
	completed.Text = done .. "/" .. #currentTree.Nodes .. " Completed!"

	-- info card
	local n = selected
	card.Visible = n ~= nil
	if n then
		cardName.Text = n.Name
		cardName.TextColor3 = currentTree.Color
		cardDesc.Text = n.Text or ""
		local cost = U.CostOf(n)
		if set[n.Id] then
			buyText.Text = "OWNED ✓"
			buyB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 110, 150)
		elseif not U.Available(n, set, stageSet()) then
			buyText.Text = "LOCKED"
			cardDesc.Text = U.LockReason(n, set, stageSet()) or ""
			buyB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 95, 115)
		elseif snow() >= cost then
			buyText.Text = "BUY  ❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(cost)
			buyB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90)
		else
			buyText.Text = "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(cost)
			buyB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 70, 80)
		end
	end
end

local busy = false
buyB.Activated:Connect(function()
	local n = selected
	if busy or not n then return end
	busy = true
	buyScale.Scale = 0.9
	tween(buyScale, 0.3, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return buyRemote:InvokeServer(n.Id) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and res == true and tiles[n.Id] then
		local t = tiles[n.Id]
		t.scale.Scale = 1.3
		tween(t.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		-- neighbours that just became available pop a little
		task.delay(0.1, function()
			for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do
				local tt = tiles[nb.Id]
				if tt then
					tt.scale.Scale = 1.12
					tween(tt.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	refresh()
end)

local dragging, dragStart, boardStart
bg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		boardStart = board.Position
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not sg.Enabled then return end
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local d = input.Position - dragStart
		board.Position = UDim2.new(boardStart.X.Scale, boardStart.X.Offset + d.X, boardStart.Y.Scale, boardStart.Y.Offset + d.Y)
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and currentTree then
		boardScale.Scale = math.clamp(boardScale.Scale + input.Position.Z * 0.08, 0.25, 1.5)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)
